name: Brooklyn BK1

address.note: Baxtel and datacenterHawk give 594 Geelong Rd; PeeringDB (src 8) and the 2021 planning application P652/2021 (src 3) give 598 Geelong Road; site spans 594-598

lat.note: geocoded: OSM address point 598B Geelong Road, Brooklyn (no OSM point for 594); approximate campus location. PeeringDB gives -37.818303, 144.842294 for BK1 (~400 m WSW) - not adopted, precision unclear

builder.note: not confirmed. Possible: Total Construction — inferred only from civil subcontractor Green Civil listing clients as "Total Constructions and CDC" (source 6); no head-contractor statement found

mw_it.note: RenewMap 'CDC Brooklyn Campus One' 155MW (operating); datacenterHawk says BK1/2 master-planned for 150,000 kW critical load at full build (src 5); CDC says Brooklyn campus >350MW at completion (src 4). 155 may be a campus-stage figure rather than a single building

cost_aud_m.note: not found; civil works package (Green Civil, src 6) valued $20m - subcontract only, not project cost; DJSIR says CDC Brooklyn+Laverton developments contribute >$4bn economic value (not capex)

pathway.note: use and development for a data centre, DDO11, native vegetation removal, TZ2 access

reference.note: Brimbank application: use and development of the land for a data centre (DDO11, native vegetation removal, TZ2 access) at 598 Geelong Road; PlanningAlerts id 2332618. Decision date not shown

lodged.note: approximate: PlanningAlerts first published 5 Feb 2022; received date not recorded (ref suffix /2021 suggests lodged late 2021)

jobs_construction.note: only 'thousands of jobs' across construction, engineering, trades, security and operations (campus-level, CDC Feb 2026 release, src 10)

construction_start.note: Green Civil civil works duration May 2022 - July 2024 (covers both initial buildings' civil works); matches datacentermap per master.csv (not re-fetchable, 429)

construction_end.note: Green Civil completion July 2024; Baxtel year built 2024 (src 2); CDC: BK1 operational since 2024 (src 4)
